references.text: Both texts are about listening to the Lord's voice and obeying him
The same theme of following the Lord, listening to his voice, and keeping his commandments
A direct parallel linking obedience to the Lord's voice with keeping all his commandments
The same expression about listening to the Lord's voice and keeping his commandments and statutes
A fundamental covenant promise to listen to the Lord's voice and keep his covenant
A promise of blessing for listening to the Lord's voice and doing everything he commands
Jesus teaches that love for him is shown by keeping his commandments
The connection between keeping commandments and remaining in God's love
Love for God is defined as keeping his commandments
